question: Pedro, a 42-year-old man, consults with his family doctor for the periodic control of high blood pressure diagnosed two years ago. The doctor verifies that the patient is a smoker of 15 cigarettes / day and proposes to the patient the abandonment of the smoking habit. Ask the patient if he / she has considered quitting before, if he / she has achieved it and has relapsed at some time. After listening to the patient's points of view in relation to smoking cessation, he identifies ambivalence of the patient in relation to his behavior and negotiates with him a plan to achieve the stated objective.
